title: BPW-2026-0539
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0539
CD 13
REQUEST FOR APPROVAL – PROPOSED NAMES FOR THE HOLLYWOOD WALK OF FAME FOR 2026
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE the proposed names from the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce (Chamber) during their annual meeting on June 22, 2026 to be installed within the Hollywood Walk of Fame Stars; and
DIRECT the Bureau of Engineering to issue an “A” permit for the installation of each name receiving a Hollywood Walk of Fame Star that has been submitted by the Chamber and approved by the Board.
